attempts.text:
Only Thakre shelter, Gajuri care home and Myagang care home are connected to the car by open roads. Tarkeshwar hospital, Suryagadhi, Likhu farm and Panchakanya can't be reached because every road into them is damaged or cut off from Thakre.

- **Cut-off groups:** The 2 injured and 1 elderly person at Panchakanya and the 7 adults at Likhu farm must be deferred. That costs 160 + 50 + 140 = 350.
- **Gajuri elderly person:** The round trip is 14 minutes, against a deferral penalty of 50, so I rescue them.
- **Myagang elderly person:** The round trip is 48 minutes, against a penalty of 50, so rescuing is slightly cheaper.

Total driving is 14 + 48 = 62 minutes.

<plan>
drive car1 thakre-shelter gajuri-care-home
load car1 elderly 1
drive car1 gajuri-care-home thakre-shelter
unload car1 elderly 1
drive car1 thakre-shelter myagang-care-home
load car1 elderly 1
drive car1 myagang-care-home thakre-shelter
unload car1 elderly 1
defer panchakanya-care-home injured 2
defer panchakanya-care-home elderly 1
defer likhu-farm adult 7
</plan>

COST: 412
